# Accounstone

> Outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation, payroll, and back-office support for CPA firms and growing businesses across the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia. Service delivery team based in New Delhi, India.

Accounstone provides outsourced accounting support including bookkeeping, accounting operations, tax preparation support, payroll processing, accounts payable/receivable, and audit support. Solutions are offered as offshore accounting support, staff augmentation, dedicated accounting teams, and back-office support, with flexible engagement models rather than one-size-fits-all packages.

## Services

- [Bookkeeping](/services/bookkeeping): Transaction recording, bank reconciliation, account maintenance, and clean monthly records.
- [Accounting Services](/services/accounting): Month-end close, account reconciliations, management reporting, and recurring accounting operations.
- [Tax Preparation](/services/tax-preparation): Return preparation support working under appropriate professional review.
- [Payroll Processing](/services/payroll): Payroll processing, employee records, and payroll-related reporting support.
- [Accounts Payable](/services/accounts-payable): Vendor records, invoice processing, approvals, and payment preparation.
- [Accounts Receivable](/services/accounts-receivable): Customer invoicing, payment tracking, reconciliations, and aging follow-up.
- [Audit Support](/services/audit-support): Documentation, schedules, evidence gathering, and coordination support for external audits.

## Company Notes

- Accounstone is a newly launched company; team members bring 24+ years of combined accounting experience.
- The team includes a QuickBooks Certified ProAdvisor (since 2022).
- The company is actively working toward SOC 2 certification and does not currently hold ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certification.
- Service delivery is based at a Global Delivery Center in New Delhi, India, serving clients in the US, UK, and Australia.
